title: Jamming at the Flurry
content: Randy Jennings is the bass player for the theNisky Dixie Cats, a 7-piece ensemble that performs Dixieland-style jazz.Dave Crump is an ear trained musician who hosts big band and do-wopp jam sessions every week in his living room. I sketched them playing at theFlurry, a huge dance festival that happens this weekend in Saratoga Springs, New York.
